title: Fullness of ordinary etale affine-line pullback
statement: For any scheme S [def-pc-scheme] and commutative ring Lambda, ordinary inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] along the affine-line projection [def-sbc-affine-space] is full on sheaves of Lambda-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. No local constancy or finiteness is required.

source.place: Tag 0A3H, lemma-sections-upstairs; fixed-module coefficient transport by sites.tex Tag 00YV and proetale.tex Tag 099Y

proof.text: The affine-line projection is smooth by [sbc-lem-affine-space-smooth], hence flat, and affine, hence quasi-compact. Its geometric fibres are irreducible by the existing Mathlib affine-space instance and therefore connected. These properties persist after etale base change.

source.place: Tag 0A3H, lemma-sections-upstairs; fixed-module coefficient transport by sites.tex Tag 00YV and proetale.tex Tag 099Y

proof.text: For every etale object V, apply Etale.isIso_upperStarSectionsMap to the identity of V times_S A1_S. The map is precisely the adjunction unit at V; its flat, quasi-compact, geometrically connected hypotheses were verified in the preceding step. This source theorem implements [lem-sbc-module-chart-sections-flat-connected] for module sections. The sheaf-to-presheaf functor reflects isomorphisms, so the unit is invertible. An adjunction with invertible unit has full left adjoint.
